assets.caption: Sections mode on a 5-node / 2-banner-group patch: circuits chained in patch order as lanes, each banner group reading as a contiguous band, cable springs intact, no overlapping bodies and no enclosing rectangles (the clustering itself is the section visualisation)

Sections mode on the 511-node scale anchor (fixtures/own_scale.ini): the same world that used to solve into a ~40:1 ribbon now reads as a grid of wrapped lane rows (bbox 3812 x 2850, aspect ~1.34), bodies separated, cable springs crossing lanes

reason: No web routes exist (native Rust desktop app; no pnpm/Chrome path), so visual evidence was captured natively: tools/screenshots/render.sh added two sections-mode shots and its full check exits 0 with every pre-existing shot byte-identical. Automated verification: cargo fmt --check clean; cargo clippy -D warnings clean; 1294 lib + 12 main + 5 perf-gate tests pass; release build succeeds. Measured layout outcomes: own_scale.ini sections-mode bbox 39,540 x 60,020 (aspect ~40:1, worst pairwise penetration 79.19) -> 3,812 x 2,850 (aspect ~1.34, worst penetration 1.05, zero pairs above tolerance).
